23110434.reason: DFS never checks the rising water level (position must exceed elapsed time), only walls and visited marks, so it accepts paths that would be flooded: n=6,k=2 '--X-X-'/'X--XX-' prints YES instead of NO.

31871384.reason: Hard-codes the wall jump as +3 (ninja(pos+3,...)) instead of +k: on n=5,k=4 it finds a nonexistent path and prints YES instead of NO.

31959794.reason: Memo vis=[[0]*n]*2 aliases both walls and only truthy results prune (failed states store 0 and are re-explored; returns vis[pos] list), so DFS is exponential; on n=101,k=1 it did not finish within 60 s vs the 2 s limit.

9741783.reason: DFS caps consecutive up-moves at k+1 (numUps == jump+1 returns False) and forbids position 0 for down moves, pruning valid climbs: n=5,k=2 with an all-safe left wall prints NO instead of YES.

9742416.reason: BFS over (wall,height,counters,water) states with no visited set, so the queue grows exponentially; on test 0023 (n=101,k=1) it exceeds the 2 s limit (sandbox: >4 s then memory exhaustion at 6 s) where an O(n) BFS answers NO instantly.
